title: Quote terms
intro: Quotes are not open yet. This is how they are meant to work.

p: The prices in a quote are fixed while the quote is valid. The default validity is 15 days. An expired quote cannot be accepted.
Accepting a quote creates an order at the quote's prices. Stock is checked again at that moment.
Every change creates a new version of the quote. A version that has been sent is never edited.
Machinery for export is quote-only and priced in US dollars. Further terms: [to be confirmed].
